# llms.txt for Pabitra Technology
# Controls how AI crawlers & Large Language Models use site content

# --- Allowed AI Crawlers ---
User-Agent: OpenAI
Allow: /

User-Agent: Anthropic-AI
Allow: /

User-Agent: Perplexity-AI
Allow: /

User-Agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /

# --- Block all unknown AI crawlers ---
User-Agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /cgi-bin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /drafts/
